tasks.prompt: Compare polling and webhooks as triggers for agent orchestration. Exactly 5 bullets, each one sentence, covering latency, reliability, operational cost, failure recovery, and when to choose each.
Explain a reconciliation loop in plain language for a non-engineer, in about 100 words, using a thermostat as the analogy. End with one sentence connecting it to AI agents.
List 5 failure modes of long-running autonomous agents (for example: context drift, stale state, runaway cost) with a one-line mitigation for each.
